positiveFlows.title: THE PROPOSED PROJECT WILL CREATE A CONSUMER-CENTRIC FRAMEWORK TO DETECT AND CONTROL LEAD IN DRINKING WATER THAT WILL COMPLEMENT THE UTILITY-CENTRIC FRAMEWORK EMBODIED IN THE LEAD AND COPPER RULE.  THE PROJECT WILL LEVERAGE CITIZEN PARTICIPATION IN DATA COLLECTION, DEVELOP PREDICTIVE MODELS THAT IDENTIFY AREAS OF VULNERABILITY TO HIGH WATER LEAD AND EMPOWER CONSUMERS WITH INTERVENTIONS TO CONTROL RISK.

THE OBJECTIVE OF THIS RESEARCH IS TO FURTHER THE SCIENCE OF RISK ASSESSMENT AND MITIGATION FOR LEAD EXPOSURE, AND TO TRANSLATE THIS INTO PRACTICES THAT LIMIT OR EVEN ELIMINATE LEAD EXPOSURE FOR DRINKING WATER CONSUMERS, ESPECIALLY VULNERABLE POPULATIONS SUCH AS CHILDREN AND PREGNANT WOMEN. THIS WORK IS APPLICABLE NOT ONLY TO SENSITIVE MEMBERS OF THE GENERAL PUBLIC, BUT ALSO SMALL AND LARGE COMMUNITIES ACROSS THE U.S. WITH DIFFERENT WATER SOURCES AND VARYING WATER QUALITY.
